messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian public‑holiday dates that create **long weekends** in 2023:

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Status |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | **February 20** | Monday | ✔️ |
| Good Friday | **March 31** | Friday | ✔️ |
| Victoria Day | **May 22** | Monday | ✔️ |
| Labour Day | **September 4** | Monday | ✔️ |
| Thanksgiving | **October 9** | Monday | ✔️ |
| Christmas Day | **December 25** | Monday | ✔️ |

> **Note:**  
> • New Year’s Day (January 1) falls on a Sunday in 2023, so it does *not* create a long weekend.  
> • Canada Day (July 1) falls on a Saturday, so it also does *not* create a long weekend.  
> • Remembrance Day (November 11) falls on a Wednesday, so it does not create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates directly into your holiday‑planning app!

But long weekends are those that fall on Friday or Monday. For 2023: Jan 1 is Sunday, so not long weekend. Family Day Feb 20 is Monday (long weekend). Good Friday Mar 31 (Friday) (long weekend).
